responsibility: Provides the low-level Rust side of the compiler’s LLVM support crate by exposing small FFI utilities used by the in-tree C++ LLVM glue and by initializing the set of LLVM backend targets that were compiled into the build. This root file defines the opaque RustString buffer bridge that lets C++ code write bytes into Rust-owned storage, exports the corresponding write function for direct linking from this crate’s C++ code, and centralizes cfg-driven target-registration calls for the available LLVM components.
